reviews.t: The Granite Mats Are Truly the Best Mats
reviews.x: I have the Granite and the Plain. Definitely go for the Granite. The Plain will show white specks and other crap very easily. The Steel Granite color will not.  These mats are truly the best. So comfortable and nice. I highly recommend the WellnessMats Granite in the Steel color. You will not be sorry.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the mat as extremely comfortable, often comparing it to standing on a cloud and praising its cushioning.
Many reviewers report that the mat relieves back, knee, and hip pain during long periods of standing in the kitchen.
Reviewers say the granite style is easy to clean and hides water stains, footprints, and specks better than the plain style.
Several reviewers praise the mat's durability, noting no curling edges, cracks, or wear over time.
Reviewers describe the mat as attractive and well-made, with colors that blend nicely into their kitchens.
